target_customer: Engineering teams (testing agent) and individual engineers running many coding agents (Orca)
problem: Hand-written end-to-end tests are costly to write and maintain; engineers running many coding agents need an orchestration environment.
business_model: B2B SaaS (Stably testing, starter plan) plus free MIT open source Orca
product_category: AI testing agents and agent development environment

founders.name: Jinjing Liang
previous_startups: second-time founder, earlier company not named on source
founders.background_notes: YC page and YC launch post

founders.name: Neil Parker
previous_startups: second-time founder, earlier company not named
founders.background_notes: YC page; one search result attributes the Uber role differently, so treated as from the YC page

technical_complexity.rationale: Test generation and self healing on top of Playwright is standard engineering with some hard parts; the 2022 product predates modern LLM agents.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations with GitHub and test suites add some lock-in, but testing agents and agent IDEs are copied quickly.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: YC launch post (about 2025) positions Stably against hand-coded Playwright and Cypress; Orca competes with agent tools from larger vendors, not documented here.

market_need_then: Not documented for 2022. The launch post claims customers replaced six figure outsourced QA contracts (company claim).

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, productivity focused (Ship 100x with the agent IDE)

brand_strength.rationale: Orca open source repo drew a reported several thousand GitHub stars (blog claim, 5.9k in one article title), but the Stably name is confusable with Stability AI in search.

pivots.to: Adds open source Orca agent orchestrator

outcome_analysis: Stably is an active developer tools company that sells an AI end-to-end testing agent and also ships the open source Orca agent environment. Verified funding is limited to an undisclosed Vercel Ventures investment in August 2025, with aggregators disagreeing on seed amounts. Its path appears to be steady and product led, but the outcome is not yet clear.
notes: Aggregators: Dealroom 125K seed, EveryDev 500K seed 2022 plus 7.2M extension 2024, Caplight 500K dated 2025-08; all unverified, not recorded. The Vercel round stage is not stated, so labeled other. No dated competitor source near 2022 found; Playwright and Cypress named in a 2025 launch post, not recorded as as of founding.
